items.reason: The investigated intervention is radiotherapy ('substituting pulsed reduced dose radiotherapy (pRDR) for standard radiation therapy'), an excluded type ('radiotherapy alone', §1.2). Temozolomide is given at standard Stupp doses in the only arm, so it is soc_backbone, not an established_therapy_experiment; established_therapy_only does not fit.

note: Phase 2, so the S6 reason appears in Figure 1. The manual does not say explicitly which S6 reason applies to a radiotherapy-question trial with only soc_backbone drugs (excluded_intervention_type vs no_pharmacological_candidate); XL should set one convention and apply it to NCT07368283 and NCT06831773 as well. MGMT tissue submission is not an entry requirement (exploratory_correlative, agreed).
